caption:
Paying ₹30,000 rent in Bengaluru: is ₹60,000 more of your HRA now tax-free?

From 1 April 2026, Bengaluru, Pune, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad joined the 50% HRA cities (earlier 40%).
HRA exempt = the lowest of: HRA received, rent minus 10% of basic, 50% of basic in these 8 cities.
Illustrative: ₹50,000 basic, ₹25,000 HRA, ₹30,000 rent → ₹25,000 a month exempt instead of ₹20,000 = ₹60,000 a year more. At a 30% slab that's about ₹18,720 less tax.
Only in the old regime; in the new regime HRA is fully taxable.
